data.name: PowerScripts_TemplateFileExtensionsHelp.Text
data.value: For example: .txt, .md or *.png. Video stays file-based: use .mp4, .webm, .mov or .mkv. Separate types with commas, spaces or semicolons. Leave blank for all file types, or use * alone. For compound names such as archive.tar.gz, use .gz. This filters selected files; it does not grant filesystem access.

data.name: PowerScripts_TemplateSetupHelp.Text
data.value: Your choices are written into the .tool.json descriptor. Image/audio input uses MIME type and base64 data; matching media output passes it through. Otherwise, media output creates a sample one-pixel PNG or silent WAV; file output creates a text file. Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, static WebP, WAV, MP3 and FLAC. Video uses files. Inline limits: 16 MiB per item, 32 MiB total. Replace the example processing after creation. Creation does not run code, approve trust or change sandbox protection.
